────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set  single-electron transfer — the_stone ⟶e⁻⟶ monad
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  photoinduced (hν): the_stone → the_stone* — ⊙ ⊙→𐑻 (excited to the EP resonance, now a far stronger donor).
  driving force (⊙, energy): the_stone is the DONOR (higher-⊙, electrons higher-lying, reducing);  monad is the ACCEPTOR (lower-⊙, oxidizing)
  electron = one winding quantum ⊡ (∮A=2πn, the quantized charge):
    donor the_stone:    ⊡ 𐑭→𐑴  (oxidized, the_stone•⁺ — gave one winding quantum)
    acceptor monad: ⊡ 𐑷→𐑴  (reduced,  monad•⁻ — took one winding quantum)
  radical-ion products:
    the_stone•⁺  ⟨𐑦𐑸𐑾𐑹𐑐𐑧𐑲𐑠𐑻𐑫𐑙𐑴⟩
    monad•⁻  ⟨𐑼𐑶𐑽𐑬𐑐𐑧𐑲𐑝⊙𐑓𐑳𐑴⟩
  invariant: total ⊡ conserved (−1 + +1 = 0) — charge conservation is the Frobenius pairing (δ/fsplit charge-separates, μ/ffuse recombines).
  channels:  μ (back-ET / geminate recombination): the_stone•⁺ + monad•⁻ → the_stone + monad, lossless (μ∘δ=id);  productive: cage escape — the free radicals do chemistry.
  mediator extrapolation_93_units (Cu-NO-class SET shuttle): can hold the intermediate (⊡=𐑴, 1≤⊡<max) — takes e⁻ from the_stone (⊡+1, reduced), delivers to monad (⊡−1, re-oxidized), returns to itself. Catalytic cycle, μ∘δ=id — regenerated, not consumed.
